authority: Closed workflow wiring only. No installed issuer, runtime credential delivery, protected execution, published observation, qualification or whole-goal acceptance.

execution.independentSelection: Explicit enable plus exact per-channel source SHA and independently selected candidate run/artifact/binary digest. Missing or malformed values refuse before private setup.
execution.candidateDownload: Immutable reviewed download-artifact action, exact artifact ID/run, digest mismatch is an error; binary hash and four current source-input hashes checked before issuer delivery.
execution.request: Fixed @beep/identity#lint activation preview, materialized dependencies, two same-source registered sibling worktrees and the complete selection; no arbitrary command or caller request file.
execution.nativeClients: Accepted stable/current-canary binary hashes; canary archive integrity and bounded single-member extraction precede any native execution.
execution.installer: Existing producer-install --from-environment with three step-only redacted records. No producer-provision or self-derived approval.
execution.runtime: Only the execution step receives trial storage/signing/reader/writer capabilities; native/backend mount and environment separation remain owned by the existing executor.
execution.privatePublication: Existing producer-publish receives only its two storage credentials and the saved issued observation. Publication cannot rerun matrices.
execution.publicArtifact: cache-producer-<run>-<attempt>, exactly one cache-producer.json, at most 64 KiB, one-day retention. Complete observation stays private in approved R2.
execution.cleanup: Frozen private output and exact sibling worktree/input paths; no forced worktree removal, no wildcard retirement of unrelated data.
execution.channelSelection: Select the nonempty secret/variable key first, then look up its value. Missing stable records cannot fall back to canary material.

syntax.scope: YAML, Bash and embedded Python syntax only. No workflow step, network transfer, credential load, tool installation or repository test executed.
